verdict.rationale: HyperAgent's page.extract() pulls structured data from pages the agent visits and can enforce a Zod schema for type-safe results. The Extract API separately accepts a defined schema plus prompt to return matching structured data, and the MCP server also exposes structured extraction. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, explicit Pydantic/Python-side schema support, and documentation of validation-failure behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract typed, schema-validated data (Zod/Pydantic-style) from pages the agent visits, not just raw text

citations.quote: Define what you want using natural language and optionally enforce a schema with Zod for type-safe results.
You can define a schema and prompt, and Hyperbrowser will extract the data matching your requirements.
powerful web automation capabilities like scraping, structured extraction, and crawling
